tests.name: toDecimal converts a positive amount into a decimal string
toDecimal omits the fractional part and separator when scale is zero
toDecimal pads the fractional part with leading zeros to match the scale
toDecimal formats a negative amount whose whole part is non-zero
toDecimal adds a leading negative sign when the whole part is a negative zero
toDecimal does not add a negative sign for a small positive amount
toDecimal formats a zero amount correctly
toDecimal passes the computed value and currency to a provided transformer and returns its result
toDecimal returns the raw decimal value when no transformer is provided
toDecimal throws when the currency has a compound (array) base
toDecimal throws when the currency base is not a multiple of ten
toDecimal throws for another non-decimal base as well
